ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Deal flow, Investment committee and later stages need Diligence complete and Amount.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Deal_flow", CASE(StageName, "Sourced", 1, "Screening", 2, "First meeting", 3, "Deep dive", 4, "Partner meeting", 5, "Term sheet", 6, "Due diligence", 7, "Investment committee", 8, "Invested", 9, 0) >= 8, OR(NOT(Diligence_complete__c), ISBLANK(Amount)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Diligence complete and Amount before moving to Investment committee.
